898-the-lesson-of-the-master.title: The Lesson Of The Master
898-the-lesson-of-the-master.creator: Unknown
898-the-lesson-of-the-master.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. “Ah yes, I know; thank you.” General Fancourt was distinguished, there was no doubt of that, for something he had done, or perhaps even hadn’t done—the young man couldn’t remember which—some years before in India.

arxiv-1809-05026.title: A Hodge filtration of logarithmic vector fields for well-generated complex reflection groups
arxiv-1809-05026.creator: Takuro Abe, Gerhard Röhrle, Christian Stump, Masahiko Yoshinaga
arxiv-1809-05026.description: Abstract . Given an irreducible well-generated complex reflection group, we construct an explicit basis for the module of vector fields with logarithmic poles along its reflection arrangement. This construction yields in particular a Hodge filtration of that module. Our approach is based on a detailed analysis of a flat connection applied to the primitive vector field.

arxiv-2109-05004.title: Kinetic interaction Morawetz and concentration estimates
arxiv-2109-05004.creator: Nima Moini
arxiv-2109-05004.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Nima Moini. In this paper we will develop the kinetic interaction Morawetz estimate for mesoscopic evolutions. Furthermore, we will find a new a-priori bound and introduce the notion of interaction uncertainty. We will demonstrate that interaction uncertainty goes to infinity with time and that the interactions, averaged over time, concentrate within a specific collection of blind cones with an arbitrarily small apex angle. These results are solely based on conservation laws and thereby are all true for the Boltzmann equation and its different variants.

arxiv-2202-10594.title: Adversarial Attacks on Speech Recognition Systems for Mission-Critical Applications: A Survey
arxiv-2202-10594.creator: Ngoc Dung Huynh, Mohamed Reda Bouadjenek, Imran Razzak, Kevin Lee, Chetan Arora, Ali Hassani, Arkady Zaslavsky
arxiv-2202-10594.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ngoc Dung Huynh, Mohamed Reda Bouadjenek, Imran Razzak, Kevin Lee, Chetan Arora, Ali Hassani, Arkady Zaslavsky. A Machine-Critical Application is a system that is fundamentally necessary to the success of specific and sensitive operations such as search and recovery, rescue, military, and emergency management actions. Recent advances in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, voice recognition, and speech processing technologies have naturally allowed the development and deployment of speech-based conversational interfaces to interact with various machine-critical applications.

arxiv-2303-14882.title: TransCODE: Co-design of Transformers and Accelerators for Efficient Training and Inference
arxiv-2303-14882.creator: Shikhar Tuli, and Niraj K. Jha
arxiv-2303-14882.description: Abstract Automated co-design of machine learning models and evaluation hardware is critical for efficiently deploying such models at scale. Despite the state-of-the-art performance of transformer models, they are not yet ready for execution on resource-constrained hardware platforms. High memory requirements and low parallelizability of the transformer architecture exacerbate this problem.

arxiv-2306-12269.title: Destructive breakdown studies of irradiated LGADs at beam tests for the ATLAS HGTD
arxiv-2306-12269.creator: S. Trincaz-Duvoid
arxiv-2306-12269.description: Abstract In the past years, it has been observed at several beam test campaigns that irradiated LGAD sensors break with a typical star shaped burn mark when operated at voltages much lower than those at which they were safely operated during laboratory tests.

arxiv-2312-07462.title: Small- x x structure of oxygen and neon isotopes as seen by the Large Hadron Collider
arxiv-2312-07462.creator: \firstname Pragya \lastname Singh \fnsep, \firstname Giuliano \lastname Giacalone, \firstname Bjoern \lastname Schenke, \firstname Soeren \lastname Schlichting
arxiv-2312-07462.description: Abstract Results on collisions of 16 O nuclei performed at the Relativistic Heavy Ion Collider (RHIC) have been presented for the first time at Quark Matter 2023 by the STAR collaboration. 16 O+ 16 O collisions are also expected to take place in the near future at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) at much higher beam energies.

arxiv-2404-10136.title: Language Model Cascades: Token-level uncertainty and beyond
arxiv-2404-10136.creator: Neha Gupta, Harikrishna Narasimhan, Wittawat Jitkrittum, Aditya Krishna Menon, Sanjiv Kumar
arxiv-2404-10136.description: Abstract Recent advances in language models (LMs) have led to significant improvements in quality on complex NLP tasks, but at the expense of increased inference costs. Cascading offers a simple strategy to achieve more favorable cost-quality tradeoffs: here, a small model is invoked for most “easy” instances, while a few “hard” instances are deferred to the large model.

Views and opinions expressed are, however, those of the authors only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or
arxiv-2410-17116.creator: Martí Alonso 1 , David Andreu 1 , Ramon Canal 1 , Stefano Di Carlo 2 , Odysseas Chatzopoulos 3 , Cristiano Chenet 2 , Juanjo Costa 1 , Andreu Girones 1 , Dimitris Gizopoulos 3 , George Papadimitriou 3 , Enric Morancho 1 , Beatriz Otero 1 , Alessandro Savino 2
arxiv-2410-17116.description: Abstract Security and RAS are two non-functional requirements under focus for current systems developed for the computing continuum. Due to the increased number of interconnected computer systems across the continuum, security becomes especially pervasive at all levels, from the smallest edge device to the high-performance cloud at the other end.

arxiv-2504-18270.title: ReGrayssion : Machine Learning-Based Analytical Expressions for Gray-Body Factors and Application to Primordial Black Holes
arxiv-2504-18270.creator: Guan-Wen Yuan, Marco Calzà, Davide Pedrotti
arxiv-2504-18270.description: Abstract Symbolic Regression (SR) is a machine learning approach that explores the space of mathematical expressions to identify those that best fit a given dataset, balancing both accuracy and simplicity. We apply SR to the study of Gray-Body Factors (GBFs), which play a crucial role in the derivation of Hawking radiation and are recognized for their computational complexity.

arxiv-2511-08817.title: Covering of an inner subset by the confined random walk
arxiv-2511-08817.creator: Nicolas Bouchot
arxiv-2511-08817.description: Abstract We consider the simple random walk conditioned to stay forever in a finite domain D N ⊂ ℤ d , d ≥ 3 D_{N}\subset\mathbb{Z}^{d},d\geq 3 of typical size N N . This confined walk is a random walk on the conductances given by the first eigenvector of the Laplacian on D N D_{N} .

pmc-10574201.creator: Zengyu Ni, Ziyue Li, Rui Shen, Siyuan Peng, Haile Yan, Yanzhong Tian, Gábor Harsányi
pmc-10574201.description: CoCrNi alloys exhibit excellent strength and ductility. In this work, the CoCrNiV multi-principal alloy with single-phase fine grained (FG) structure was prepared by rolling and heat treatment. The characteristics of deformation microstructures and mechanical properties were systematically investigated by scanning electron microscope (SEM) and transmission electron microscope (TEM).

pmc-10664762.title: Exploratory factor analysis of items for evaluating healthy lifestyles related to mental health among undergraduate students.
pmc-10664762.creator: Zarizi Ab Rahman, Badrul Isa, Mohd Sazili Shahibi, Muhammad Irsyad Mansor
pmc-10664762.description: Introduction:A healthy lifestyle is pivotal for improving mental health. As the concept of a healthy lifestyle is comprehensive, there is a need to prioritise components related to mental health in planning proper mental health interventions. In this regard, physical activity, diet, sleep quality, substance abuse and social support have been identified to enhance mental health.

pmc-11322182.title: A novel development of wide voltage supply DC–DC converter for fuel stack application with PSO-ANFIS MPPT controller
pmc-11322182.creator: C H Hussaian Basha, Faisal Alsaif
pmc-11322182.description: The present power production companies are working on renewable energy systems because their features are more reliable for the local energy consumers, high continuity in the energy production, and less cost is required for maitainence. In this article, the proton exchange membrane fuel stack (PEMFS) renewable energy is utilized to supply energy to the automotive systems.

pmc-11434474.title: Strength of London Dispersion Forces in Organic Structure Directing Agent—Zeolite Assemblies
pmc-11434474.creator: Karima Ata, Tzonka Mineva, Bruno Alonso
pmc-11434474.description: Herein, we study the London dispersion forces between organic structure directing agents (OSDAs)—here tetraalkyl-ammonium or -phosphonium molecules—and silica zeolite frameworks (FWs). We demonstrate that the interaction energy for these dispersion forces is correlated to the number of H atoms in OSDAs, irrespective of the structures of OSDAs or FWs, and of variations in charges and thermal motions.

pmc-11435622.title: The Emerging Fusarium graminearum NA3 Population Produces High Levels of Mycotoxins in Wheat and Barley
pmc-11435622.creator: Nicholas A. Rhoades, Susan P. McCormick, Martha M. Vaughan, Guixia Hao
pmc-11435622.description: Fusarium graminearum (Fg) is the primary causal agent of Fusarium head blight (FHB) in wheat, barley, and other small grains in North America and worldwide. FHB results in yield reduction and contaminates grain with mycotoxins that pose threats to human and livestock health.

pmc-11471855.title: Aerosol immunization with influenza matrix, nucleoprotein, or both prevents lung disease in pig
pmc-11471855.creator: Eleni Vatzia, Basudev Paudyal, Barbara Dema, Brigid Veronica Carr, Ehsan Sedaghat-Rostami, Simon Gubbins, Bhawna Sharma, Elliot Moorhouse, Susan Morris, Marta Ulaszewska, Ronan MacLoughlin, Francisco J. Salguero, Sarah C. Gilbert, Elma Tchilian
pmc-11471855.description: Current influenza vaccines are strain-specific and require frequent updates to combat new strains, making a broadly protective influenza vaccine (BPIV) highly desirable. A promising strategy is to induce T-cell responses against internal proteins conserved across influenza strains. In this study, pH1N1 pre-exposed pigs were immunized by aerosol using viral vectored vaccines (ChAdOx2 and MVA) expressing matrix (M1) and nucleoprotein (NP).

pmc-11673161.title: Fitness of Mythimna separata (Lepidoptera: Noctuidae) on Cultivated Wheat and a Weed, Wild Oat (Avena fatua), and Its Implications for Pest Management
pmc-11673161.creator: Qinjian Pan, Junyu Shen, Lvming Su, Zexiang Nie, Ikkei Shikano, Tong-Xian Liu, Lin Chen, Leon G Higley
pmc-11673161.description: Simple SummaryMythimna separata (Walker) is a migratory pest that is widely distributed in many Asian countries, including China. Though it is known to have a wide range of hosts, few studies have assessed the insect’s fitness on various host plants, especially weeds. Understanding the fundamental biology and ecology of this pest is crucial for developing effective control methods.

pmc-11862738.title: Sleep disorders in patients with bipolar disorder: age and tobacco consumption correlates
pmc-11862738.creator: K Razki, C Najar, S Ben Aissa, M Oumaya, R Bouzid
pmc-11862738.description: IntroductionSleep disruptions are frequently observed in individuals with bipolar disorder and have been linked to various unfavorable consequences, such as an elevated risk of relapse and lower quality of life. Nonetheless, the impact of sociodemographic factors on the development and progression of these disruptions remains largely unexplored.

pmc-12436930.title: Financial performance of people with affective disorders: A prospective, European-wide study
pmc-12436930.creator: T Jiang, G Gaastra, J Koerts
pmc-12436930.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionFinancial capability, which encompasses both financial competence and financial performance, is a key requirement for an autonomous and independent life. However, individuals with psychiatric disorders often report difficulties with financial capability and financial stress.ObjectivesThe current study aims to disclose the impact of affective disorders (AD) on financial performance using prospective data from wave 8 and wave 9 of the Survey of Health, Retirement and Ageing in Europe (SHARE).MethodsThe SHARE project includes individuals born on or before 1971 or households with at least

pmc-12589816.title: Validation of knowledge‐based and multicriterial optimization assistive auto‐planning algorithms for prostate VMAT radiotherapy using biological optimization
pmc-12589816.creator: Willem P E Boonzaier, Lourens J Strauss
pmc-12589816.description: PurposeExternal beam radiotherapy for cancer treatment historically has faced the challenge of delivering sufficient dose to the target while minimizing dose to critical organs. Inverse planning techniques in modulated therapy can improve organ‐at‐risk (OAR) sparing but require significant human resources and can depend on planner experience.

pmc-12590173.title: Does human cytomegalovirus provide a novel therapeutic target for patients with glioblastoma?
pmc-12590173.creator: Cecilia Söderberg-Naucler, Mattia R Pantalone, Giuseppe Stragliotto, Jiri Bartek
pmc-12590173.description: Glioblastoma is the most common and aggressive primary malignant brain tumour in adults, with limited treatment options despite years of research. Since the 2005 introduction of the current standard of care, hundreds of clinical trials have failed to deliver significant breakthroughs. In 2002, human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) was detected in 100% of glioblastoma tumours.

pmc-12639652.title: Occult medial orbital wall trapdoor fracture inducing recurrent rhinogenic intraorbital abscess in a pediatric patient: a case report
pmc-12639652.creator: Ligang Jiang, Xin Jiang, Wencan Wu, Fangzheng Jiang
pmc-12639652.description: BackgroundIn pediatric populations, rhinogenic intraorbital abscess is frequently encountered, typically resulting from the direct extension of acute sinusitis. However, recurrent rhinogenic intraorbital abscess secondary to an occult medial orbital wall trapdoor fracture is extremely rare and often overlooked due to atypical trauma history and subtle imaging features.

pmc-12654770.title: Implant Surface Variability Between Progressive Knife-Edge Thread Design and International Organization for Standardization Thread with and Without Tapping Area: A Model Analysis
pmc-12654770.creator: Davide Farronato, Luca Poncia, Marco Vidotto, Vittorio Maurino, Leonardo Romano, Eugenio Velasco-Ortega, Bongju Kim
pmc-12654770.description: An implant’s thread design plays a key role in enhancing primary stability by optimising the distribution of loading forces and biomechanical structural interlocking. An increase in bone-to-implant contact (BIC) surface availability affects osseointegration timing and leads to different biomechanical behaviours.

pmc-12830666.title: Development for soft actuator with multilayer structure and its application
pmc-12830666.creator: Gyeongji Kang, Kahye Song
pmc-12830666.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Most actuators require considerable degrees of freedom to perform tasks effectively, which often leads to larger size and reduced portability. As an alternative, soft actuators have been introduced, offering compact form, high maneuverability, and multiple modes of motion. In this study, a Hydraulically Amplified Self-Healing Electrostatics (HASEL) actuator was configured in a layered structure to achieve practical usability and efficient movement. The actuator operates through hydraulic pressure and volumetric expansion generated under high voltage.

pmc-13057408.title: Recurrent Ectopic Pregnancies Following Bilateral Partial Salpingectomy: A Case Report
pmc-13057408.creator: Monica Hill, Panagiotis Cherouveim, Shagun Tuli, Jay Holmes
pmc-13057408.description: BackgroundEctopic pregnancies can be a life‐threatening condition in early pregnancy. Risk factors include pelvic inflammatory disease, prior ectopic pregnancy, pelvic surgery, and anatomical variations. Although pregnancy after tubal sterilization is uncommon, recurrent ectopic pregnancy after bilateral partial salpingectomy is rare.CaseA 28‐year‐old G5P1031 African‐American patient who underwent cesarean delivery with bilateral partial salpingectomy.

pmc-13399685.title: Double Transverse Mini‐Incision Repair for Proximal Achilles Tendon Tears
pmc-13399685.creator: Taylor Stauffer, Ryann Davie, Josh Bram, Emily Smith, Tony Wanich
pmc-13399685.description: Recent literature showing equivalent outcomes for surgical and nonoperative management of Achilles tendon ruptures emphasizes the importance of proper indications for surgical repair. Various techniques for tendon repair via reapproximation of the torn ends have been described, such as open, mini‐open, and minimally invasive, each with their own advantages and disadvantages.

pmc-13436881.title: Erector spinae plane versus transversus abdominis plane block for hysterectomy: Beyond statistical significance
pmc-13436881.creator: Alessandro De Cassai, Giulia Aviani Fulvio, Burhan Dost, Annalisa Boscolo
pmc-13436881.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Despite its prevalence, hysterectomy is not without important consequences, both physical and psychological. Among these, chronic postsurgical pain develops in approximately 10%–50% of patients, with up to 7% experiencing severe and persistent pain, particularly following abdominal approaches.[2] Given this burden, optimizing perioperative analgesia is of paramount importance, and as expected that considerable research efforts continue to focus on improving pain management strategies in this population.
